housing.text: Adams supports cutting red tape that delays housing and shelter development.
housing.quote: Cutting red tape that slows down shelter and housing development

safety.text: Adams supports mental-health crisis teams and other community-based responses aimed at addressing underlying causes of instability.
safety.quote: More crisis response teams trained in mental health intervention

sentencing.text: Adams said California should emphasize rehabilitation and reconsider law-enforcement responses to mental-health crises.
sentencing.quote: Asked about criminal justice reform, Adams said the state should emphasize rehabilitation and rethink how law enforcement responds to situations such as mental health crises.

health.text: Adams supports universal health coverage for all Californians, though he has not specified the coverage mechanism.
health.quote: I will tirelessly champion policies that ensure universal health coverage for all Californians, working towards a system where financial barriers do not prevent anyone from receiving necessary medical care.

tax.text: Flora’s campaign pledged to keep taxes down for working families.
tax.quote: Count on him to keep taxes down on working families.

wages.text: Flora repeatedly voted against AB 1228, which established a $20 hourly minimum wage for fast-food employees and authorized future increases.

safety.text: Flora said he sponsored legislation to strengthen law enforcement's ability to protect children and advanced measures targeting retail theft and fentanyl.
safety.quote: This year, I’ve sponsored legislation to combat wildfires and introduced multiple bills to strengthen law enforcement’s ability to protect children from human traffickers. I’ve also advanced legislation to take action against retail theft and fentanyl in our neighborhoods.

sentencing.text: Flora introduced AB 1898 to make repeat offenders convicted of specified child-pornography and child-sex felonies ineligible for sentence-reduction credits.
sentencing.quote: This bill would include specified felonies involving, among other things, the knowing depiction, production, distribution, advertising, possession, control, and use of material depicting a person under 18 years of age engaging in or simulating sexual conduct, as defined, in the list of felonies that the commission of which make a person ineligible for credits against a sentence as provided above.

guns.text: Flora repeatedly voted against SB 2, which added concealed-carry licensing requirements and restrictions on carrying firearms in specified places.
